entry.title: "Not now, not ever": Australia Forgot This Football Team Existed | Devil Inside

media:group.media:title: "Not now, not ever": Australia Forgot This Football Team Existed | Devil Inside
media:group.media:description:
Tasmania is about to make history — but long before the AFL ever came knocking, the state already had a team. The Tassie Devils played eight seasons in the VFL between 2001 and 2008, reached a Preliminary Final, and then quietly disappeared. Most of Australia has no idea they ever existed. From the AFL's repeated rejections of Tasmania's bids, to the politics that killed the original club, to what a permanent AFL team finally means for a state that has waited longer than anyone. The Devils are back, and this time, they're not going anywhere.
